MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 37

2. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 3
   C. 41
   D. 13

3. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 28
   C. 29
   D. 11

4. Solve for x: x + 4 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 4

5. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 11
   C. 25
   D. 24

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 48

7. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

8. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 17
   C. 0
   D. 8

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 24

11. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 13
   D. 7

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

13. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

14. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 2

15. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

16. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
